title: ALN Token Database (tokens.json) — v2
description: Schema for the shared token definitions produced by scripts/sync_notion_to_tokens.py and consumed by the backend orchestrator, GM scanner, web player scanner, and ESP32 scanner. v2 (A3 slice 2b): SF_Group carries the PURE group name — the '(xN)' microformat is retired; multipliers are pack RULES in game.json `groups`, and the activation gate refuses tokens naming undeclared groups. SF_MemoryType is an OPEN pack-declared id (exact-case; the gate refuses types absent from the pack's own scoring.typeMultipliers — the closed ALN enum died with the R11 genericization). Invariant not expressible here: each token's SF_RFID must equal its object key (enforced by the backend contract test and the sync script's alignment check).

image.description: Memory image shown by player scanners, relative to the token-data root. BMP only — the ESP32 renderer cannot decode other formats

audio.description: Memory audio played by player scanners, relative to the token-data root

video.description: Video filename (no path) played by the orchestrator on TV when a player scans this token

processingImage.description: Interstitial image shown while a video token is queued. BMP only, as with image

SF_RFID.description: Token identifier — MUST equal this token's object key

SF_ValueRating.description: 1-5 star rating; multiplied with the SF_MemoryType multiplier per game.json scoring.typeMultipliers

SF_MemoryType.description: Pack-declared memory type id driving the scoring multiplier — OPEN vocabulary, EXACT-CASE (v2/R11: the engine's activation gate refuses ids absent from the pack's own scoring.typeMultipliers). null is tolerated but scores 0x (UNKNOWN) — the sync script warns

SF_Group.description: PURE group name (v2) — '' means no group. The completion multiplier lives in game.json `groups` (D1b); the activation gate refuses a token naming an undeclared group. The '(xN)' suffix is RETIRED and schema-illegal

summary.description: Public summary shown on the scoreboard when the token is exposed via a Detective transaction

owner.description: Character who owns this memory (resolved from Notion's Elements→Characters relation, role prefix stripped)
